title: EcmascriptConfig
description: Parser, token-reduction, and source-rendering settings for JavaScript, JSX, TypeScript, and TSX.

parser.title: Parser settings
parser.description: Settings used when parsing source before printing and when validating synchronized output.

sourceType.description: How Babel interprets scripts and modules.

tokens.title: Token settings
tokens.description: Controls syntax-preserving reductions emitted by the typed token printer.

collapseSingleStatementBlocks.description: Remove eligible braces around a single statement when safe.

source.title: Source rendering settings
source.description: Controls whitespace and line endings in lean output.

spaceAroundOperators.description: Render spaces around operators when true.

spaceAfterControlKeywords.description: Render a space after control-flow keywords when true.
